  PROBLEM: The `SANDBOX_INCOMPATIBLE_PATTERNS["git_remote_op"]` regex matches only when the subcommand comes straight after `git`, so git global options before the subcommand defeat it. Examples: `git -C . fetch origin main`, `git --git-dir=… pull`, `git -c core.longpaths=true clone …`. The `git remote` alternation has the same gap.
  WHY: Such a verdict passes `--sandbox-check`, so scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1572 sets `validate_ok=true` and the re-ask at :1587 is never reached. The implementer's isolated repository has no remote and no network, so the fetch fails and the fix-up does not land. `git -C <dir> fetch` is the house idiom in this repo. Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER, minimax/openai/qwen=MAJOR; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 agreed the gap is accurate but listed it only as hardening, because the gap predates this run and the check is a heuristic backstop.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:267 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `gh_cli` pattern `\bgh\s+(api|pr|issue|run|repo|release|workflow)\b` leaves out `gh label`, `auth`, `secret`, `search`, `status`, `gist` and `codespace`. The agents.d/changelog.d docs and prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt describe the gate as refusing "a `gh` command".
  WHY: An instruction such as `gh label create ai:blocked …` passes `--sandbox-check` and then fails in the implement sandbox, where `gh` is absent and the token is stripped (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1897). The fix-up then stalls or lands half-applied. The reviewer rated it NIT because only a peripheral step is affected.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:lines 254-259, `SANDBOX_INCOMPATIBLE_PATTERNS[git_remote_op]` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The subcommand must be the first token after `git`, so global options (`git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin main`, `git --git-dir=… pull`, `git -c core.longpaths=true clone …`) defeat every pattern. `origin_ref` requires `/`, so it does not catch these either. The `git remote` alternation has the same gap.
  WHY: `_check_sandbox_instructions` (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:1008-1009) passes these instructions, scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1572 sets `validate_ok=true`, and the re-ask at :1587 is skipped. The fix-up carries a fetch that cannot run (the fun-token-multi-chain#639 failure mode). The idiom is common in this repo: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:516, scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:223, scripts/release_manifest_publish.sh:145. Suggested fix: `\bgit\s+(?:-{1,2}[^\s]+\s+)*(fetch|pull|clone|push|ls-remote)\b`, plus the same optional run before `git\s+remote\s+`.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:line 267, `gh_cli` pattern | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gh label`, `auth`, `secret`, `search`, `status`, `gist` and `codespace` are missing, even though agents.d/7742-unblock-sandbox-instructions.md, changelog.d/7742-unblock-sandbox-instructions.md and prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt say the gate refuses any `gh` command. `gh label create` is used in scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:39 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4037.
  WHY: The instruction passes `--sandbox-check` and then fails in the sandbox, where `gh` is absent and the token is stripped (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1897). The fix-up stalls or lands half-applied. Suggested fix: add `auth|label|secret|search|status|gist|codespace`.
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/unblock_ledger.py
  1. Line 257, second alternation: add `|set-head|set-branches|clean`.
  2. Line 263, `package_install`: add `|pipx\s+install|conda\s+install`.
  Each change is 1 line, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
